description: Angular component for entity subtype autocomplete input, managing form control, fetching subtypes, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: EntitySubTypeAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a subtype autocomplete input with dynamic subtype fetching and form control integration.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up broadcast subscriptions, and configures subtype filtering based on entity type.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from broadcast events to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current value of the input and updates form state.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if dirty.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: fetchSubTypes
methods.description: Fetches and filters subtype list based on search text.

methods.name: getSubTypes
methods.description: Retrieves subtype list observable, with caching and filtering.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and resets focus.
